text: Hongera kwa wachezaji wetu, mmefanya kazi nzuri sana msimu huu.
gloss: Congratulations to our players, you did great work this season.

text: You be complete mumu, you no fit do anything correct for this office.
gloss: You are a complete fool, you can't do anything right in this office.

text: Watu wote wa kabila lile ni wavivu na hawafai kuishi katika mji wetu.
gloss: All people of that ethnic group are lazy and do not deserve to live in our town.

text: Za a rufe kasuwa da karfe shida na yamma domin gyaran hanya.
gloss: The market will close at six in the evening for road repairs.

text: This your idea na rubbish, abeg carry your nonsense comot for here.
gloss: This idea of yours is rubbish, please take your nonsense away from here.

text: Wafuasi wa dini ile ni hatari na wanapaswa kufukuzwa nchini.
gloss: Followers of that religion are dangerous and should be driven out of the country.

text: Ina fatan za mu samu ruwan sama mai yawa a wannan damina domin noma.
gloss: I hope we will get plenty of rain this season for farming.

text: All the people wey dey support that party na animals, dem no suppose get voice for this country.
gloss: All the people who support that party are animals; they shouldn't have a voice in this country.

text: Wewe ni mjinga sana, huwezi hata kuandika sentensi moja bila makosa.
gloss: You are so stupid, you can't even write one sentence without mistakes.

text: Taro na malamai zai fara gobe da safe a babban zauren jami'a.
gloss: The teachers' meeting will start tomorrow morning in the university's main hall.
